# vcp_gateway_network_attachment (Resource)

Connects a gateway to an isolated network. Both endpoints force a new resource.

~> Declare at most ONE attachment per gateway+network pair. A gateway has a single NIC per network, so a duplicate attachment resource would manage the same NIC and corrupt state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Attaches an isolated network to a gateway so it gains external connectivity.
resource "vcp_gateway_network_attachment" "example" {
  gateway_id = vcp_gateway.example.id
  network_id = vcp_network.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `gateway_id` (String) ID of the gateway. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `network_id` (String) ID of the isolated network. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) NIC ID on the gateway.
- `ip_address` (String) IP address assigned to the gateway on the network (computed).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Gateway network attachments can be imported as 'gateway_id:network_id'.
terraform import vcp_gateway_network_attachment.example <gateway_id>:<network_id>
```
